text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Traaaineer!!" his

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "So fun~! I had such a blast, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How was my run?
Did you enjoy watching it!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Trainer is so happy too!
It makes me happy as well!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's both en-JOY the next race too!

And so, the day after
her successful debut race...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... thank you for your hard work, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I watched your debut race!
It was a wonderful performance that really showed your growth.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut is behind us,
so I suppose this is where the real challenge begins, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your future plans yet?
—Umamusume have what are known as "aptitudes."

I've always sensed something brilliant
in Taiki Shuttle's speed.

And judging by her run in the debut race,
Taiki Shuttle is definitely best suited
for sprints and miles.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Is something troubling you,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Taiki's goal is to become "Umamusume of the Year"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, the Eight Major Races, which naturally draw the most attention and acclaim—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That is to say, we would love to aim for
the Classic races or the Tenno Sho, but...

In a race that doesn't match her aptitudes,
she probably won't be able to get the results she hopes for...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...You seem deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: When you're feeling lost, returning to the starting point is a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you go see
your trainee?

Taking Tazuna's advice,
I went looking for Taiki Shuttle—

I spotted her on the track,
hard at work doing independent training.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew~! Going full speed really feels amazing, yes it does!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, are you ready?
Then, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Alright then... start!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Suzuka and Air Groove!
Are you running together!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Heeeeeeeey!!
Please let me run with you tooooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Whoooosh!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

Air Groove and Silence Suzuka had already started
hundreds of meters ahead.

However, Taiki Shuttle managed to catch up.
At terrifying speed.

A clump of turf sent soaring by those powerful legs
brushed against my cheek—
—My mind was made up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer-san!
What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's right.
The Make Debut is just the beginning...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next! Which race should I run in!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for "Umamusume of the Year,"
I shall seize victoryyyy!!

Taiki Shuttle's determination is unyielding.
What I must say to her now is—
choice_data_list: Let's master sprint and mile racing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Short distances or miles?
Does that mean races around 1600 meters?
"Proceeding down that path will make the road to becoming the 'Umamusume of the Year' extremely arduous."

Still, even if the odds are near-miraculous...
With her legs, she just might make it!
choice_data_list: Let's show them your power and speed!
Let's show off your power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Power and speed?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The greatest charm...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeeeeeehaaaaaw!!
Okay, I got it!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gettin' so hyped up, YES!
Let's charge right through sprints and miles, YES!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So, which race is next!?

The path is set. In that case, next up
is the mile race held in Kyoto this winter—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Understood! For the Shinzan Kinen,
it's training and training!
